name: Create Folder
description: Create a new empty folder. [See the documentation](https://developers.google.com/drive/api/v3/reference/files/create) for more information

configurable_props.name: drive
configurable_props.label: Drive
configurable_props.description: Defaults to `My Drive`. To select a [Shared Drive](https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9310351) instead, select it from this list.

configurable_props.name: parentId
configurable_props.label: Parent Folder
configurable_props.description: Select a folder in which to place the new folder. If not specified, the folder will be placed directly in the drive's top-level folder.

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Name
configurable_props.description: The name of the new folder

configurable_props.name: createIfUnique
configurable_props.label: Create Only If Filename Is Unique?
configurable_props.description: If the folder already exists, **do not** create. This option defaults to `false` for backwards compatibility and to be consistent with default Google Drive behavior.
